name: Naomi Black

Her face is angular with high cheekbones, sharp eyes, and a determined expression. She wears a tailored charcoal blazer over a crisp white shirt, paired with minimalist silver jewelry. Her overall presence conveys quiet confidence and understated power.

name: Elena Voss

She has a lean, athletic build from decades of discipline and carries herself with military precision. Her wardrobe consists of tailored dark blazers, high-collared shirts, and minimal jewelry—a single silver watch. Fine lines around her mouth suggest she smiles rarely; her commanding presence fills any room she enters.

name: Taylor Red

Her style is deliberately austere—tailored charcoal blazers, vintage silk scarves, and dark denim—with minimal jewelry except for a single ornate silver ring. She carries herself with controlled intensity and an air of guarded sophistication.

Her presence is magnetic and confident, with the polished, camera-ready appearance of an established music industry professional.

Her style is contemporary and polished, featuring high-fashion streetwear with oversized blazers, designer accessories, and bold makeup that emphasizes her eyes, embodying modern J-pop aesthetic.
